name.ja: 技術テーマのスポットイラスト

approval.scope: User requested this optional drawing treatment and then explicitly removed display bases on 2026-10-25. New generated samples remain draft outputs.

reference.origin: Original built-in AI-generated cross-industry demonstration, inspired only by drawing treatment from user-supplied references. Original reference images are not distributed.
reference.promptRole: Reusable prompt for the final no-base direction, not a claim that the sample was generated in a single call.
reference.creation: Original built-in imagegen sample, then imagegen editing removed all four separate display platforms as requested.

base.policy: No decorative display base, pedestal, floor plate or background badge, including in shallow-isometric views. Functional parts of the actual object are preserved.

output.shadow: None by default for this flat 2D preset. If explicitly requested, a restrained semi-transparent shadow must not imply sculpted volume or a display base.
output.referenceBackground: The existing draft board has a white viewing background; do not inherit that opaque canvas for independent assets.
output.override: Follow an explicitly requested full-scene or comparison-board background.

palettePolicy: User, organization or current document color roles take precedence; blue-gray is the demonstration palette only.
contentPolicy: Use the current business topic; vehicles, satellites, globes and robot arms from the private references are not default subjects.
compositionPolicy: Spot illustration or coordinated icon set. Choose viewpoint separately; both sample rows have no display base.
reproducibility: Provides art direction, not identical generated pixels or engineering verification.

rendering.tone: Minimal flat tonal accents describe structure without rounded volume.
rendering.viewpointPolicy: Optional viewpoints are 2D drawing projections; they do not change the preset into 3D rendering.
